headline: Back-to-back durability confirmed as the brisk 12 km follows yesterday's long run without HR drift, capping a genuine four-week volume build.
confidence_reasons: Multiple data sources active in last 3 days
summary:
The pairing you saw yesterday has now repeated with intent: a longer time-on-feet effort followed by a brisker morning run, and the HR on today's faster pace sat mid-range rather than climbing under accumulated fatigue. That's the durability signal, not a one-off — exactly the quality a self-supported multi-day crossing rewards. Your recent four-week block sits well above the prior one, and unlike a spike that outruns its base, the strain:tolerance balance stayed level through it, so this is load you've absorbed rather than borrowed against.

Underneath the volume, the aerobic picture keeps trending the right way — easy-effort HR is running lower than the comparable prior period on more runs, which is the kind of within-athlete signal that matters more than any single session. Strength frequency has more than doubled versus the previous block, so the hybrid base is holding while endurance volume rises rather than one displacing the other. This is consolidation of a genuine build, not fatigue accumulation.

The one thing worth naming plainly: with the crossing now under a month out, pack-loaded running and sustained climbing still haven't clearly entered the picture. Today's elevation was modest and the long run carried more, but neither yet resembles the sustained border-section demand.
watch_items: Whether pack-loaded running finally enters the schedule with the crossing now inside a month.
Whether per-run climbing builds toward the sustained mountain section rather than staying rolling.
Whether short-sleep nights cluster as longer sessions and back-to-backs continue, or stay isolated.
Whether the strain:tolerance balance holds level if volume keeps climbing from here.

evidence_items.text: ▲ 4-week volume 190 km vs 126 km prior block (+51%)
▼ Easy-run HR averaging 145 bpm vs 153 bpm prior period (comparable-effort runs, 9 vs 8 runs)
▬ Strain:tolerance ratio 0.99 (MAINTAINING) (strain 91, tolerance 92); sleep averaging 7h29m over the same period
